text: State unemployment rates in Sept. 2026 ranged from 2% in SD to 5.6% in DC.
In Q2 2026, house prices declined year-on-year in CA, CO, NM, and WA.
Q2 2026 state GDP growth over the year ranged from -2.1% in DC to 4.6% in NY.
Among states, Sept. 2026 average weekly earnings ranged from $1,019 in MS to $1,498 in WA.
In Sept. 2026, manufacturing jobs fell year-over-year in 20 states and DC.
Q2 2026 accommodation and food services GDP was below 2019 levels in HI and 17 other states.
In Sept. 2026, 7 states had their lowest federal employment in at least a decade.
In Q2 2026, house prices in NM declined year-on-year for the first time in 14 years.
Just two states saw retail GDP grow 1% or more between Q2 2025 and Q2 2026: AL and MO.
In Sept. 2026, public education jobs fell year-over-year in 26 states.
